# Nogent 3 Etoiles

> French cutlery specialist offering premium folding pocket knives and kitchen cutlery with traditional craftsmanship.

Nogent 3 Etoiles is a French knife manufacturer focused on high-quality folding and pocket knives. The site showcases their product catalog featuring classic designs with options for serrated and smooth blades.

## Key Topics

- Folding knives
- Pocket knives
- Kitchen cutlery
- French cutlery
- Serrated blade
- Smooth blade
- Couteau Pliant
- Classic Bois
- 8cm blade
- Knife shop
